metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2011 · Thor
metas.description: The powerful but arrogant god Thor is cast out of Asgard to live amongst humans in Midgard (Earth), where he soon becomes one of their finest defenders.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2016 · Doctor Strange
metas.description: While on a journey of physical and spiritual healing, a brilliant neurosurgeon is drawn into the world of the mystic arts.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2017 · Wonder Woman
metas.description: When a pilot crashes and tells of conflict in the outside world, Diana, an Amazonian warrior in training, leaves home to fight a war, discovering her full powers and true destiny.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2014 · The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
metas.description: Bilbo Baggins and company are forced to engage in a war against an array of combatants and keep the Lonely Mountain from falling into the hands of a rising darkness.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2016 · Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
metas.description: In 1926, magizoologist Newt Scamander arrives in New York during his worldwide tour to research and rescue magical creatures as something mysterious leaves trails of destruction in the city, threatening to expose the wizarding world.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2010 · Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A young man must defeat his new girlfriend's seven evil exes, who are willing to do anything to prevent her happiness with someone else.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2017 · The Shape of Water
metas.description: At a top secret research facility in the 1960s, a lonely janitor forms a unique relationship with an amphibious creature that is being held in captivity.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2017 · Beauty and the Beast
metas.description: A brave, beautiful, and brilliant young woman is imprisoned by a beast in his castle. Despite her fears, she learns to see beyond the beast's hideous exterior and realize the gentle heart of the true prince within him.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2016 · The Witch
metas.description: An isolated Puritan family in 1630s New England comes unraveled by the forces of witchcraft and possession.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2019 · The Lighthouse
metas.description: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2019 · Doctor Sleep
metas.description: Years following the events of The Shining (1980), a now-adult Dan Torrance must protect a young girl with similar powers from a cult known as The True Knot, who prey on children with powers to remain immortal.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2015 · The Age of Adaline
metas.description: An ageless woman meets someone who reawakens her passion for life and romance.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2018 · Black Mirror: Bandersnatch
metas.description: A young programmer starts to question reality when he adapts a mad writer's fantasy novel into a video game.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2010 · Let Me In
metas.description: A bullied young boy befriends a young female vampire who lives in secrecy with her guardian.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2013 · Only Lovers Left Alive
metas.description: A depressed musician reunites with his lover. However, their romance, which has already endured several centuries, is disrupted by the arrival of her uncontrollable younger sister.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2012 · Ruby Sparks
metas.description: A novelist struggling with writer's block finds romance in a most unusual way: by creating a female character he thinks will love him, then willing her into existence.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2012 · Beasts of the Southern Wild
metas.description: Faced with both her hot-tempered father's fading health and melting ice-caps that flood her ramshackle bayou community and unleash ancient aurochs, six-year-old Hushpuppy must learn the ways of courage and love.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2018 · Mirage
metas.description: Vera, a mother of one, interacts with the ghost of a child and saves his life. However, her actions cause a space-time continuum glitch, altering reality.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2019 · Weathering with You
metas.description: Set during a period of exceptionally rainy weather, high-school boy Hodaka Morishima runs away from his troubled rural home to Tokyo and befriends an orphan girl who can manipulate the weather.
